obligation: G067 -- physical cost vs capability per family, cliff located as a number

method.error: output-space relative Frobenius on real captured BF16 parent activations
method.why_not_weight_cosine: Q30 was calibrated on a broken model and the sub-bit negatives were synthetic-activation artefacts; G036 requires fitting against the teacher function
method.intrinsic_rule: bits/elem of maximum curvature in log(error) vs bits, anchored to nothing
method.anchored_rule: bits/elem where the family's error crosses flat q2's error at the SAME site, interpolated; q2 is the recorded DEAD artifact so this transfers a real capability verdict across families at matched cost
method.circularity_declared: for the FLAT family the dead anchor IS a family member, so its anchored number is the anchor by construction and only the intrinsic number is informative there

limitation: the anchors' capability verdicts come from a TEN-ITEM gate, which G046 and G048 already measured as too narrow to certify equivalence. These PTPs are as strong as those verdicts and no stronger.

family_crossover.reading: The two families CROSS. Below the crossover the planes ladder has lower functional error than the flat code at matched bits; above it the flat code wins. And the planes family has a FLOOR the flat family does not: at the top of the sweep planes are still 14-28x the flat error, because each additional plane corrects a shrinking residual while another bit of a flat code halves the step everywhere. So planes are a low-bit mechanism with a ceiling, not a cheaper version of the flat code.
